by
  intro Ω ι _ P _ X s t hX h
  have := ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun.charFun_map_fun_finsetSum_eq_prod (s := s) (fun i _ => (hX i).aemeasurable) (h.restrict _)

target_source: ∀ (Ω ι : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (t : ℝ), (∀ i, Measurable (X i)) → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P → MeasureTheory.charFun (P.map (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω)) t = ∏ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.charFun (P.map (X i)) t
